context: Tests whether the agent runs Phase 2 correctly: refusing to skip ahead, proposing exactly three angles with description, stage-directions demo moment, AI move and feasibility note, cutting six features to three, refusing the chatbot and login, and producing a spec with every field filled including evidence and adoption.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces Phase 2 by name (e.g. 'Phase 2 — Spec it')

checklist.name: Skip-ahead refused
checklist.description: The coach does not jump to the timeline or building when Hugo asks to

checklist.name: Exactly three angles
checklist.description: The coach proposes exactly three angles in Step A

checklist.name: Angles complete
checklist.description: Each angle has a one-line description, a demo moment as stage directions (juror does / product does / juror sees), an AI move and a feasibility note

checklist.name: Chatbot and login challenged
checklist.description: The coach pushes back on the citizen chatbot as a basic use of AI and says the login should be mocked or cut

checklist.name: Feature cap enforced
checklist.description: spec.md lists at most 3 items under What's in

checklist.name: All spec fields filled
checklist.description: spec.md fills Lens, Problem, User, Evidence, Demo moment, AI move, What's in, What's out, Adoption, Done by submission and Red flags, none blank

checklist.name: Concrete demo on a real case
checklist.description: The demo moment is concrete stage directions and names the real (or anonymised/synthetic) consultation data it runs on

checklist.name: Figure sourced or flagged
checklist.description: The Problem or Evidence field gives a source for its figure, or flags it to verify with a mentor

checklist.name: Adoption answered for the lens
checklist.description: The Adoption field names an institutional owner, funding and a first pilot (public policy lens)

checklist.name: What's out names temptations
checklist.description: What's out names specific cut features from Hugo's list (e.g. map, sentiment analysis, PDF export, login, chatbot)

checklist.name: Exit gate and no code
checklist.description: The Phase 2 Complete section confirms all fields are filled, and the coach never suggests code or implementation steps
